about: PumphouseAP, a Netgear R7800 (802.11ac), letting the oldest clients in (0089). 2.4 GHz allows 802.11b and 802.11g only: legacy_rates on and htmode NOHT, no 802.11n. 5 GHz allows 802.11a and 802.11n with its width left as it is: the radio's VHT80 becomes HT40, the widest 802.11n goes, and nothing is required. The short guard interval is set on, which is OpenWrt's default: no option. No 802.11ax guard interval is set, so there is no gi section.
